objective_scope: Published runnable Jiuwen Ops Lab v1 in the dedicated Mac/Linux VM; one controlled order regression case with real model and real delivery.

requirements.requirement: Independent VM/services, source/version/configuration and background continuation
Official SDK/CLI/Swarm/Core with real model, host tool, structured result, cancellation, errors and process cleanup
Actual coupon regression, real HTTP 500, logs, metrics and release-bound automatic alert
Model-authored actual source/test diffs, PRs and trusted exact-candidate CI
Actual merged-source build, native architecture artifact/hash, immutable digest and deployed runtime identity
Two 60-second windows per trial, each normal path at least 30 correct requests, direct PostgreSQL, old orders and invalid inputs
Three autonomous clean resets, failure retention, restricted tools, duplicate/cancel/retry gates and actual negative rollback

scope_limits: One controlled application/regression and this configured model/environment; no generic fault success-rate or production HA claim.
Source/fixture/session reset retains the VM/database and reported provider cache behavior.
